description: This is a React-based Next.js page component that renders a homepage fetched from server-side data and client-side data, demonstrating integration with Keystone.js APIs, GraphQL requests, and React hooks.

methods.name: getServerSideProps
methods.description: Fetches users data from Keystone backend during server-side rendering using Next.js's getServerSideProps.

methods.name: ServerRenderedContent
methods.description: React component that displays list of users fetched server-side.

methods.name: ClientRenderedContent
methods.description: React component that fetches and displays list of users on the client-side using useEffect and GraphQL request.
